sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Warren Dunes State Park: /api/maps + /api/resourcelocation/resources + /api/attribute/filterable + /api/equipment, maps 'Mount Randall Campground', 'Mount Randall Campground & Mini Cabins', 'Hildebrandt Campground')

values.note: DNR rate table, Mount Randall modern campground: 20/30-amp $45, 50-amp $50; its one full-hookup site ($60) is the camp host's site June-August. Hildebrandt semi-modern (no electric) $40, but the booking site takes only tents there. Mini cabins $80. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Warren Dunes / Mount Randall Campground: full-hookup $60, 50 AMP $50, 20/30 AMP $45; Hildebrandt Campground - Semi Modern $40, 'Semi-modern sites do not have electric'; Mini Cabins $80) + https://midnrreservations.com/ catalog (all 37 Hildebrandt sites allow only 'Tents'; Mount Randall site 83, the only full-hookup site: 'This is the Host site June-August') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/warrendunes (Recreation Passport required), read 2026-10-22. The stored $40 low was Hildebrandt's tent-only rate and the $60 high the host site's.

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/warrendunes (Mt. Randall tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + https://midnrreservations.com/ catalog (181 Mount Randall sites 'Electric Only', 68 of them 20/30/50 amps; Sewer Hookup No on all but site 83, the June-August host site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Mt. Randall modern (two loops) 182 sites, Hildebrandt semi-modern 37 sites (tents only on the booking site). Mt. Randall sites are small: on the booking site 49 take rigs only to 20 ft, 44 are tent-only, and about 90 take 25 ft or more (only 15 take 35 ft or more, 4 to 50 ft); 5 are pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/warrendunes ('Number of sites: 182' Mt. Randall, '37' Hilldebrandt; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + https://midnrreservations.com/ per-site allowed equipment ('Trailer or RV up to N'') and Pull Through attributes, read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/warrendunes (Mt. Randall tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Concession or store'; Hilldebrandt: 'Vault toilets are centrally located ... three modern toilet and shower buildings are available ... at the Mt. Randall modern campground'; tag 'Sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/warrendunes (Mt. Randall and Hilldebrandt: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Base corrected $40 -> $45 and high $60 -> $50: the $40 is Hildebrandt's semi-modern rate and the booking site takes only tents there, and the $60 full-hookup rate is the June-August camp host's site; Mt. Randall is $45 (20/30-amp) / $50 (50-amp), Recreation Passport in fees.note. Added 50-amp electric only, 219 sites (182 + 37), up to 50 ft with 5 pull-throughs but mostly short sites, showers/flush and vault toilets/dump/store, reservable on midnrreservations.com. Season May 1 - Oct 21 already manual. --AWH note kept. Website (DNR page first) and phone 269-426-4013 match.
flags: Fees overwritten on an entry whose fees provenance (DNR rate table, 2026-10-09) carries no method: the old $40-60 took the low from the tent-only Hildebrandt loop and the high from the camp host's full-hookup site. If that provenance counts as manual, keep it and treat this as the disagreement.
Site size: on the booking site 49 of Mt. Randall's sites take only 20 ft and 44 are tent-only; about 90 take 25 ft or more, so a 23-ft rig must pick its site.
